title: Invisible workload — myth flip (Meera, 43) · Zarit Burden screen
caption:
Myth: you're just bad at delegating. Truth: the remembering and planning is unpaid work — women do 76% of it worldwide (ILO 2018). Ask a clinician about the Zarit Burden screen.
Which myth should we flip next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#invisiblelabor #mentalload #caregiverburnout #womenshealth #fairplay

scenes.text: Myth: "you're just *bad* at delegating." No. The load is real, and it's measurable.
Meera is 43. She runs the 8am standup, refills the inhaler, and remembers every birthday.
phrases: Nobody asks her to remember the inhaler refill.
She just does it, between standups.
The job nobody wrote down is still a job.

scenes.text: "Just ask for help," they say. She did — and got asked what needs doing.
phrases: "Deciding what to do IS the work."

scenes.text: Of 53 million unpaid US caregivers, 61% are women. Almost 1 in 4 report worse health.
Write the five things only you remember. Hand one over whole — the deciding included.
phrases: Write the 5 things only you remember.
Hand ONE over completely, deciding included.
Then walk 20 minutes (WHO: 150 min a week).
Fair Play calls that owning the whole card.
